youtube.title: Why Spiders Don't Get Stuck in Their Own Web 🕷️ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
In an orb web, only the spiral capture threads are coated with sticky glue. The radial spokes and the frame threads are dry, and the spider moves mainly along those. Its legs also carry fine hairs and a thin oily coating that keep contact with the glue to a minimum.
